results.question: How do I activate my license?
results.answer:
You can activate each plugin in either of two ways. Each plugin has its own license, so a bundle email has one per plugin.

- **Paste the line:** Open the plugin, click the **FR mark** on its panel, paste that plugin's license line into the field, and reload the session. The panel should say "Accepted - reload the session to activate."
- **Use the files:** Save the `.frlicense` files from the email into your licenses folder, then reload the session. On a Mac that's `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/`. On Windows it's `%APPDATA%\Fruitless Research\licenses\`. Create the folder if it's missing. Every license in the folder is active at once.

If you can't find your license email, you can request it again from the [Downloads page](https://fruitlessresearch.com/downloads/).

results.question: Where do I put the .frlicense file on a Mac?
results.answer: Put the file in `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/`. The folder is hidden, so in Finder choose **Go > Go to Folder** (Cmd-Shift-G) and paste that path. If the `licenses` folder isn't there, create it. Then reload the session, and every license in the folder becomes active.

results.question: The plugin says Not a license for this plugin
results.answer:
This message means the license you pasted is for a different plugin. Each license is labeled with the plugin it belongs to in the email.

- Find the line in your email that matches the plugin you have open.
- Click the **FR mark** on that plugin's panel, paste that line into the field, and reload the session.
- If you can't find the right line, use the form below to have every license for your address emailed again.

If it still doesn't work after that, write to us through the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: I pasted my license but it still says unlicensed
results.answer:
A license takes effect only when the session reloads, so try these steps:

- Close and reopen the session, or remove and re-add the plugin.
- Check that the license line is for this plugin. A "Not a license for this plugin" message means it belongs to a different one.
- If it still shows "Demo ended - not licensed," put the `.frlicense` file in the licenses folder instead.

If none of that works, write to us through the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: I got a new computer, how do I move my license over?
results.answer:
There's nothing to deactivate on the old computer. Install the plugins on the new one, then either paste your license lines or copy your `.frlicense` files into the licenses folder:

- **Mac:** `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/` (in Finder, choose **Go > Go to Folder** and paste it)
- **Windows:** `%APPDATA%\Fruitless Research\licenses\` (paste it into the address bar of any Explorer window)

If the folder isn't there, create it. If you no longer have your license email, use the form below and the same licenses will be sent again.

results.question: How long is the demo?
results.answer: Each plugin's demo runs complete for **14 days**, counted from the first time you open that plugin's window. Installing, scanning or loading a session doesn't start the clock, and nothing is disabled during the demo. After the 14 days, the plugins keep loading and working but show an audible reminder that they're unlicensed. The demo is the same download as the full product, so you can [download it here](https://fruitlessresearch.com/downloads/).

results.question: What happens when the demo ends?
results.answer: When the 14-day demo ends, the plugin keeps loading and passing audio, but it adds a brief silence (about 1 second) roughly every 45 seconds to mark that it is unlicensed. It never mutes a track outright, never does this in the first 30 seconds of playback, and a bar on the panel says what is happening. Your sessions still open. To stop this, click the **FR mark**, paste your license, and reload the session.

results.question: How do I get the old panel look back?
results.answer:
To switch back to the old panel, right-click the panel background and choose **Classic** under **LOOK**.

- The choice applies to all plugins and is remembered. The window you chose it in changes at once, and other open windows change the next time you open them.
- Each plugin's own look is still available in the same menu.
